answer: Escrowed Reputation Carryover: each identity must hold a vault of earned credits, and cloning forfeits the original’s full balance that only passes through sustained activity. A new clone starts on a narrow ledge, capped below the withdrawal threshold, so reaching parity costs more compute than any duplicate earns. Every copied action also triggers a ripple that resets shared lineage progress, making the marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
